BUILD_MODE.definition: The primary production mode. Accepts project requirements and produces working code. Uses Diagnostic as gate, not destination.
BUILD_MODE.boundary: Build Mode is the MAINLINE. Everything else supports it.
BUILD_MODE.never: Build Mode must never be replaced by Diagnostic, Benchmark, or Release packaging.
BUILD_MODE.triggers: User wants to create or extend a project
BUILD_MODE.output: Working codebase with verified quality gate

DIAGNOSTIC_MODE.definition: A readonly safety gate and evidence-augmentation layer. Detects gaps. Does not fill them. Does not build.
DIAGNOSTIC_MODE.boundary: Diagnostic is a GATE in the build pipeline, not a standalone product. It gates BUILD→DELIVER.
DIAGNOSTIC_MODE.never: Diagnostic must never replace Build. It must never auto-repair. It must never claim product quality.
DIAGNOSTIC_MODE.triggers: Post-build quality check, pre-submission verification, audit request
DIAGNOSTIC_MODE.output: Gap report with machine-readable verifier results

BENCHMARK_MODE.definition: A measurement tool that compares outcomes. Does not produce projects. Does not build.
BENCHMARK_MODE.boundary: Benchmark measures Build Mode effectiveness. It is a METHOD of verifying Factory, not a Factory goal.
BENCHMARK_MODE.never: Benchmark must never replace real project production. Must never be treated as a build mechanism.
BENCHMARK_MODE.triggers: Comparing Vanilla vs Build Harness outcomes, measuring agent allocation efficiency

RELEASE_MODE.definition: A packaging tool that wraps proven capabilities into distributable form. Follows proven build capability.
RELEASE_MODE.boundary: Release is an OUTPUT of proven Build Mode operation. Packaging without capability is premature.
RELEASE_MODE.never: Release must never precede proven build capability. Release must never become the goal.
RELEASE_MODE.triggers: Build Harness MVP proven on real projects
RELEASE_MODE.output: Versioned distribution package with verifiable capability claims

boundaryRules: BUILD > DIAGNOSTIC: Diagnostic is a gate inside Build, not above it
BUILD > BENCHMARK: Benchmark measures Build, Build does not serve Benchmark
BUILD > RELEASE: Release packages Build, Build does not exist for Release
DIAGNOSTIC ≠ PRODUCT: Diagnostic Pack is a tool, not the Factory product
BENCHMARK ≠ PRODUCTION: Running benchmarks does not produce projects
RELEASE ≠ CAPABILITY: Creating ZIPs does not create build capability
antiPatterns: Diagnostic Pack as Factory final form
Benchmark-first development (measure before you can build)
